_about: 1-Butanol (1) + n-Butyl acetate (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1-butanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 1-butanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: J. Cai, S. Zhen, D. Gao, X. Cui, Phase Equilibrium (VLE, LLE, and VLLE) Data of the Ternary System: Ionic Liquid [OMIM][PF6] + Butan-1-ol + Butyl Acetate, J. Chem. Eng. Data 59 (2014) 2171-2176
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 3, 4. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0070. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.26 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
